recipes.title: Protein Banana Bread
recipes.twist: Sunday bake for the week's desserts. One slice is about 180 kcal with 12g protein.

portion.jevon: 1 slice

ingredients: 1 tsp baking powder + ½ tsp bicarb soda
method: Oven to 180°C. Line a loaf tin with baking paper.
Blitz the oats into flour in the blender.
Mash the bananas, then whisk in the eggs, yoghurt and maple.
Stir in the oat flour, whey, baking powder, bicarb, cinnamon and salt until just combined. Fold in the choc chips.
Bake 40–45 min until a skewer comes out clean. Cool in the tin 10 min.
Cut into 8 slices. Fridge for 5 days, or freeze slices and toast from frozen.

recipes.title: Yoghurt Berry Bowl
recipes.twist: Two-minute dessert. Tastes like dessert, eats like a protein snack.

portion.jevon: 150g fat-free Greek yoghurt · 80g berries · 5g PB2 · maple

ingredients: 5g PB2, mixed with a splash of water
Optional: a few dark choc chips or a pinch of cinnamon
method: Microwave the berries 30 sec so they go jammy.
Yoghurt in a bowl, berries on top with their juice.
Drizzle the PB2 and maple over the top.

recipes.title: Green Recovery Smoothie
recipes.twist: Post-gym breakfast for the morning-training trial. More fruit when you need more carbs.

portion.jevon: 250ml coconut water · 250ml light milk · 100g berries · spinach · greens · 200g fat-free yog · 30g whey · 10g PB2
portion.jaiden: 250ml coconut water · 250ml light milk · 100g berries · spinach · greens · 150g fat-free yog · 30g whey · no PB2

ingredients: Extra banana or fruit if you want more carbs
method: Liquids into the blender first, then spinach and greens powder.
Add berries, yoghurt, whey, PB2 and maple.
Top with ice and blend 45–60 sec until smooth.
Lighter version (Thu/Fri): water instead of coconut water, skip the PB2.

recipes.title: Beef, Mushroom & Zucchini Mince Bowl
recipes.twist: Built from the Monday Aldi shop. Simple, savoury, cooks in 20 minutes.

portion.jevon: 1 portion mince · 100g egg whites · 250g roast sweet potato · cos
portion.jaiden: 1 portion mince · 100g egg whites · 200g roast sweet potato · cos

ingredients: 2 tsp smoked paprika or whatever spices are in the cupboard
~1.4 kg sweet potato, cubed and roasted
Egg whites, scrambled fresh at lunch
method: Sweet potato into the oven at 200°C for 35–40 min.
Brown the mince hard in a big pan, breaking it up. Tip off excess fat (4-star has a bit more).
Push to one side, add onion and garlic for 3 min.
Add mushrooms and zucchini, cook 8–10 min until the mushrooms have given up their water.
Season with paprika, salt and pepper.
Split into 6 containers with the sweet potato: Tue, Wed and Thu lunches for both of us.

recipes.title: Smoky Beef & Bean Chilli Bowl
recipes.twist: Parked for Week 2. 1 kg of mince makes 6 portions: 4 lunches and 2 frozen.

portion.jevon: 1 portion chilli · 100g egg whites · 300g potatoes · greens
portion.jaiden: 1 portion chilli · 100g egg whites · 250g potatoes · greens

ingredients: 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp chilli, 1 tsp oregano
Egg whites, scrambled fresh at lunch
method: Brown the mince in your biggest pot, breaking it up. Tip off excess fat.
Add onion, capsicum and garlic. Cook 5 min.
Stir in the spices and tomato paste for 1 min, then the tomatoes and beans.
Simmer uncovered 30 min until thick. Season.
Portion 6 containers: 4 to the fridge, 2 to the freezer.
At lunch: reheat, scramble 100g egg whites for 2 min, serve with potatoes.

recipes.title: Garlic-Ginger Beef Bowl
recipes.twist: Second batch style so lunches change halfway through the week.

portion.jevon: 1 portion · 100g egg whites · 300g roast baby potatoes · kimchi
portion.jaiden: 1 portion · 100g egg whites · 250g roast baby potatoes · kimchi

ingredients: 4 garlic cloves + a thumb of ginger, grated
1.2 kg baby potatoes, halved and roasted
method: Brown the mince hard in a hot pan.
Add garlic and ginger for 1 min.
Add broccoli and zucchini with a splash of water; cover 3 min.
Stir through tamari and sesame oil. Finish with spring onion.
Portion into 4 with the roast potatoes.

recipes.title: Baked Feta Chicken & Sweet Potato Tray Bake
recipes.twist: One tray, two nights. Wednesday dinner, then Thursday leftovers.
recipes.creator: @adamhoad_coaching

portion.jevon: 1 serve + 150g baby potatoes + big salad

ingredients: Salt, pepper, garlic granules, mixed herbs
Dressing: 100g Greek yoghurt, 10g tahini, 1 tbsp cumin, juice of 1 lemon, salt, 50ml water
method: Heat oven to 200°C.
Tray: sweet potato, broccoli, onion, chickpeas and feta. Season well. Roast 30 min.
Add the chicken, roast 20–25 min more.
Whisk the dressing until smooth and drizzle over.
Eat 2 serves, box 2 for tomorrow.

recipes.title: Sunday Roast Chicken, Potato & Pumpkin
recipes.twist: Cook a big bird. Leftover chicken becomes Monday's lunch.

portion.jevon: 220g chicken · 250g potato + pumpkin · greens

method: Oven to 200°C. Lemon and garlic in the cavity, oil and salt the skin.
Chicken in the middle, potatoes and pumpkin around it.
Roast ~75 min until juices run clear. Rest 10 min.
Steam greens while it rests.
Strip the leftover meat into a container for Monday.

recipes.title: Rump Steak, Sweet Potato & Broccolini
recipes.twist: The Alfie plate: good steak, orange carb, green veg, avo.

portion.jevon: 200g rump · 300g sweet potato · broccolini · ¼ avo
portion.jaiden: 200g rump · 250g sweet potato · broccolini · ¼ avo

method: Roast sweet potato wedges at 220°C for 25 min.
Steaks out of the fridge 20 min early, salt well.
Sear 3 min a side in a very hot pan, rest 5 min.
Blanch or pan-char the broccolini. Slice avo, squeeze lemon.

recipes.title: Salmon, Baby Potatoes & Big Salad
recipes.twist: Oily fish night. Crispy skin, lemon, lots of green.

portion.jevon: 180g salmon · 300g baby potatoes · salad

method: Boil potatoes 15 min, then crush lightly.
Salmon skin-side down in a hot oiled pan for 5 min, flip for 2.
Toss salad with lemon and a little oil.

recipes.title: Barramundi, Potatoes, Slaw & Avo

portion.jevon: 200g barra · 300g potatoes · slaw · ¼ avo

method: Roast or boil potatoes.
Pan-fry barra skin-side down 4 min, flip 2.
Toss slaw with a spoon of yoghurt and lime.

recipes.title: Berry Protein Smoothie
recipes.twist: Post-training breakfast. Blend and go.

portion.jevon: with 30g oats

method: Everything in the blender, blend 45 sec.

recipes.title: Protein Oats
recipes.twist: Full breakfast before a midday session.

portion.jevon: 60g oats

method: Microwave oats and milk 2 min.

portion.jevon: 2 rice cakes · 1 banana · ~5g honey · ~5g PB2

ingredients: ~5g PB2 (powdered peanut butter), mixed with a splash of water
method: Mix the PB2 with a little water and spread on the rice cakes.
Banana on top, small drizzle of honey. Flex the honey/PB2 ratio to taste.

portion.jevon: 170g Greek yoghurt · apple or pear · 20g nuts

method: Fry or scramble the eggs. Toast the sourdough. Plate with avo, tomato and fruit.

portion.jevon: 150g tuna · 200g cooked rice · avo · kimchi

method: Rice in a bowl, tuna on top, then cucumber, avo and kimchi. Splash of tamari.

recipes.title: Taco Beef & Sweet Potato Mash
recipes.creator: @themacrosnerd
recipes.twist: Meal prep for 5. A good swap for the chilli in Week 2.

portion.jevon: 1 of 5 serves

ingredients: 2 packs taco seasoning (or cumin, paprika, chilli, garlic, oregano to keep it whole-food)
method: Poke holes in the sweet potatoes, spray with oil, wrap in foil and air fry at 200°C for 45 min.
Cook the beef with the seasoning until done.
Stir the corn and black beans through the beef.
Cool the potatoes, split across 5 containers and mash.
Add the beef mix alongside and salt each serve.
